zortax_quick1.title: zortax gui-bench quick run 1
zortax_quick1.label: Rough baseline only
caveats: Busy host: other processes used about 70 % of 16 CPUs (load average 20-30); 280 of 535 reports fail the harness's own validity checks (wake_lateness); values marked † come from an invalid report.
Software rendering: fakeland's pixman compositor and lavapipe software Vulkan (ilo-prod has no GPU), --quick mode, nice 19.
172 cells: 154 completed, 18 stopped after startup (floem: a 1 px border drawn across a pixel boundary fails the layout check in 16 of 17 cells; vizia: typing and search paint nothing).

bough is not in this matrix: it has no Linux backend yet (the platform lane is bringing one up). Nothing here compares with bough's macOS numbers: other host, other ISA, whole-process CPU time under software rendering versus instructions on the calling thread.
Ripple and Solid are not comparison targets.
zortax_quick1.identity: ilo-prod (AMD Ryzen 7 3700X, governor powersave, boost on), kernel 6.18.54, gui-bench 0fd45107, fakeland 71695e7c, 2026-11-12, flattened by the research lane (RESULTS.md, metrics.tsv, validity.tsv on branch lane/research/round6 efdc4e5bc7)
zortax_quick1.scenario_note: rows scenario at 3,000 rows unless the metric names another; lower is better for every metric
